name: QBO.Error.ServerError
meaning: Builds a QBO (QuickBooks Online) 500 error object: scriptName, descriptor, data, errorCode -2, errorMessage "500 Internal Server", code 500, and type, which is set to "JSON" and then overwritten by "QBO".
open_question: The "type" key is set twice; the second value ("QBO") wins. Check whether JSON.Format output in the first set matters.

name: QBO.Error.UnAuthorized
meaning: Builds a QBO 401 error object: scriptName, descriptor, data, errorCode -2, errorMessage "401 Unauthorized", code 401 (as string), type "QBO".

name: z_FM.GetQBOTermID
meaning: Maps a payment term text to the QuickBooks Online Term id: Due on receipt 1, Net 15 2, Net 30 3, Net 60 4, Net 10 5, Net 0 6, Net 45 7, Net 90 8, Pre-Paid 9, In Review 10, Suspended 11. Any other text returns an empty result.
open_question: Mapping table is business data and may need to live as data. Unmatched term returns empty (Case with no default). Inverse of z_FM.GetFMTerm.

name: z_FM.GetFMTerm
meaning: Maps a QuickBooks Online Term id to the FileMaker payment term text: 1 Due on receipt, 9 Pre-Paid, 10 In Review, 11 Suspended, 6 Net 0, 5 Net 10, 2 Net 15, 3 Net 30, 7 Net 45, 4 Net 60, 8 Net 90. Anything else returns empty.

name: FieldName
meaning: Returns the field name part (after "::") of a field reference; if GetFieldName returns "?" it uses the text given.

name: TableName
meaning: Returns the table occurrence part (before "::") of a field reference; if GetFieldName returns "?" it uses the text given.

name: QBO.OpenInvoices
meaning: Returns open (balance > 0) invoices of a customer as a JSON array of arrays [total, date, balance, fmId, qboId]: field names come from Config("Invoice.fields.*"), a SQL query is built with the SQL.* helpers and run with ExecuteSQL (customer id bound), and the rows are wrapped. SQL error gives QBO.Error("SQL Error, trying to get open Invoices"); no rows gives "[]".
target_signature: qboOpenInvoices(customerId: string): Array<[total, date, balanceDue, fmId, qboId]>
open_question: Calls Config and QBO.Error, which are not in this share (not found in karbon_LedgerLink's explored batch). The row values are strings, because every value is quoted in the output; confirm. invoiceIsPaid and invoiceTotal config keys are read but only some are used. No caller found.
